patterns.note: Asymmetrical content blocks are used for feature sections, such as the recipe spotlight, where a large image occupies one side and descriptive text with a call-to-action is positioned on the other.
Horizontal scrolling carousels are employed for displaying product collections and user-generated content, indicated by partial items visible at the edges of the viewport.
A vibrant, warm yellow (#fdcd62) serves as a primary accent color, consistently used for call-to-action buttons and key highlights against darker backgrounds.
A sophisticated pairing of a bold, elegant serif font for display headings and a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and smaller informational labels creates a distinct typographic hierarchy.

No scroll-triggered motion (like parallax or sticky transformations) is observable from the provided single full-page screenshot; however, horizontal content carousels are present for product collections and user content, suggesting swipe-based navigation.
Sections are clearly delineated by full-width background color changes or large, immersive imagery, creating distinct visual breaks and guiding the user through content blocks.

technique_notes: Interactive horizontal carousels are implemented for product collections and social proof sections, allowing users to browse content by swiping, leveraging a library like Swiper.js.

Subtle element animations and hover effects are likely driven by CSS keyframes, contributing to a lively but not overly distracting user experience, though specific scroll-triggered reveals are not observable from the provided images.

A full-screen modal with a distinct light blue background and bold typography appears on page load or interaction, featuring playful product cutouts with a red outline, providing a high-impact call to action.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold serif headings (~3-4x body) are paired with clean sans-serif body text and smaller, often uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card elements, with sharper edges for overall section containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing overall, with airy sections in the hero and recipe blocks, and denser content in product grids and comparison tables.

standout: The site's distinctive use of vibrant, almost illustrative product photography combined with a sophisticated serif typeface for headings creates a unique blend of artisanal charm and modern elegance. The full-screen discount modal, with its bold color and playful product cutouts, is also a memorable and high-impact element.
